rules.reason: Source-run user reports and failure records
Release archives; Git ignore is not a deletion policy
Historical acceptance report and comparison data
Generated fixtures and protected acceptance data share this root
Cache, build stages, diagnostics and unfinished evidence
Upstream runtime downloads; costly to fetch again
May contain a test log that failed to archive
Isolated application snapshots and generated media; test runner removes only its own sandbox after evidence is committed and verified, interrupted runs require inspection
